items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Hoagy Carmichael come in the studio; we were recording something else when he come in.

ctx.x: Most of the numbers we knew what we were going to do. But when you were down there with Louis, you'd never know what you're going to record. Because somebody would walk in with anything, and he would say "Yes," and here you would be.

That happened with "Mahogany Hall Stomp" and "Old Rockin' Chair". Hoagy Carmichael walked in. "Louis, I want you to do this (?). Can you record this for me?" [POPS' VOICE] "Yeah, man. Yeah, man." He'd never say no. He'd
